identity.title: PIT Market-Universe Alpha Discovery, Material Change, Triage, Reopen Decisioning and Research Queue Core
identity.objective: Implement a deterministic local/offline Alpha discovery control plane over verified PIT market evidence with explicit Alpha-memory temporal posture: stable semantic T0 observed-universe snapshots, exact freshness and material-change semantics, typed Alpha subject matching only when current registry use is permitted, fail-closed historical Alpha-memory replay, one closed pre-outcome triage basis per market, deterministic core/exploration/audit allocation, final triage/skip evidence, prospective capture-request data, and separate append-only discovery memory. No product network, Hermes, scheduler, Alpha-registry mutation, qualification, economics, paper, execution or live authority.

scope.rollback_surface: Revert S10-ALPHA-02. The additive alpha_discovery.py and alpha_discovery_registry.py modules, package exports, focused tests, discovery contract/status/spec artifacts and bounded repo-truth compatibility edits disappear. Canonical PIT records/store/query code, ALPHA-01 records/registry, WALLET-01/02, Hermes, WP170/172/173, dependencies, workflows, credentials and trading/runtime authority remain unchanged. No repository-tracked discovery database, market fetch, provider call, order, paper/live state or capital exists to unwind.

api_matrix.reason: S10-ALPHA-02 adds a bounded local/offline deterministic discovery/triage surface and separate append-only discovery registry while consuming existing PIT and Alpha Factory APIs read-only.

items.before: ALPHA-01 records research memory but has no canonical PIT universe, material-change, skip logging, deterministic research allocation or automatic reopen-decision layer.
items.after: Content-addressed policy/universe/change/final-triage/queue records plus an internal pre-allocation basis provide deterministic observed-universe triage with stable T0 universe identity, explicit Alpha-memory temporal posture, canonical PIT subject matching and no network/economic authority.
items.compatibility_requirement: PIT visibility remains delegated to the existing as-of query; current ALPHA-01 schema is read-only and provides no historical availability proof; untyped subject refs remain valid ALPHA-01 data but are nonmatching in ALPHA-02; legacy WP49-64 priority code remains noncanonical.

items.before: No durable append-only canonical history exists for universe/skip/change/queue decisions.
items.after: A separate bounded SQLite registry persists only ALPHA-02 content-addressed decision evidence with hash-chain integrity and no mutation.
items.compatibility_requirement: Distinct application id/schema/file from ALPHA-01 and WP170; no migration or mutation of either existing registry.

items.before: No ALPHA-02 discovery API is exported.
items.after: ALPHA-02 records/builders/registry constants/functions are additively exported.
items.compatibility_requirement: No existing export is removed/reinterpreted and no network/Hermes/qualification/trading API is exposed.

semantic_fields.reason: The Side12-corrected contract freezes Alpha-memory temporal availability, direct canonical PIT subject namespaces, exact PIT semantic identity/freshness and review-conflict overlays, candidate/family-grouped reopen, material-change formulas, shared persisted-record semantic validation, closed triage/priority semantics, deterministic no-backfill allocation, append-only persistence and non-authority.

items.required_rule: Every material threshold/allocation knob is explicit and content-addressed; queue capacity, nonzero exploration/audit slots, category cap, eligible statuses, freshness windows, Decimal soft-change thresholds, audit seed and taxonomy version have no hidden selection-affecting defaults.
items.validation_rule: Invalid/float/nonfinite thresholds, zero configured exploration/audit, duplicate statuses or capacity contradictions fail closed; policy mutation changes id.

items.required_rule: Historical visibility is delegated only to separate family-scoped query_point_in_time_record_set calls with AS_OF_INGESTION_TIME and include_conflicts_for_review=true. Direct verified-store access may only build a complete static entity/filter plus lineage closure without time/latestness filtering; >256 projected records fails PIT_QUERY_INPUT_LIMIT_EXCEEDED rather than truncating. Q-METADATA uses canonical Gamma source, Q-BOOK canonical CLOB source, Q-RULE all resolution sources, and referenced SourceSnapshotRecord visibility is separately proved by Q-SOURCE VISIBLE_HISTORY plus exact source_snapshot_id match. Authoritative/history records alone provide state; review-conflict records never replace authority and only apply exact market, token, resolution-source, or referenced-source overlays. Conflict-only metadata never admits a market.
items.validation_rule: Post-cutoff ingested metadata/rule/book/referenced source never enters T0; static projection cannot filter by time/latestness; 257-record entity closure fails closed; a source snapshot discoverable in the store but absent from T0 VISIBLE_HISTORY remains SOURCE_EVIDENCE_MISSING; invalid shared query result fails closed. Real shared-query review conflicts preserve authoritative payloads and apply only the exact metadata/book/rule/source overlay; conflict-only metadata is excluded.

items.required_rule: AlphaUniverseSnapshot semantic identity binds included-market query spec hashes, query engine/parameter version, exact authoritative T0 record ids and normalized T0 state, but excludes complete current-store digest/count, validated_batch_sha256, full result_sha256/exclusion counts and no-result candidate queries.
items.validation_rule: Appending an unrelated post-cutoff store record leaves T0 snapshot mapping/id unchanged while changing a true T0 authoritative record changes it.

items.required_rule: Complete triage is over the frozen observed PIT universe only; external all-Polymarket completeness is UNPROVEN and cannot be upgraded in this WP.
items.validation_rule: No builder/mapping accepts a proven-complete external claim.

items.required_rule: AS_OF_INGESTION_TIME/ingestion_time controls historical inclusion; envelope.observed_time controls metadata/book/rule/source freshness. FRESH iff 0<=age<=threshold; STALE iff age>threshold; future/malformed observed_time is INVALID_CLOCK.
items.validation_rule: Timestamp substitution, negative age and threshold off-by-one behavior fail the focused oracle.

items.required_rule: Exactly two explicit analysis modes exist: HISTORICAL_REPLAY requires HISTORICAL_AVAILABILITY_UNPROVEN and forbids loading/hashing the current Alpha registry; CURRENT_BUILD_ANALYSIS requires CURRENT_REGISTRY_BUILD_TIME_ONLY and may bind the current verified Alpha head but is never valid historical selection replay. research_as_of never proves registry availability.
items.validation_rule: HISTORICAL_REPLAY rejects current-registry posture; a candidate/family/episode added today with earlier research_as_of cannot alter historical T0 triage/priority/reopen/coverage/id. CURRENT_BUILD_ANALYSIS is identity-distinct and explicitly invalid as historical selection replay.
items.safe_output: identity-bound HISTORICAL_REPLAY or CURRENT_BUILD_ANALYSIS with fixed Alpha-memory posture

items.required_rule: Only exact existing canonical PIT market:/event:/token: identifier strings can match ALPHA-01 subject_refs; no additional outer prefix is invented. Arbitrary/noncanonical refs remain valid ALPHA-01 data but are nonmatching. Condition id has no separate v1 subject-ref namespace because canonical event id already carries Gamma condition identity when present.
items.validation_rule: Same raw suffix across canonical market:/event:/token: namespaces cannot cross-match; invented `market_id:`/`event_id:`/`token_id:` outer prefixes and fuzzy/prose matching are forbidden.

items.required_rule: Every hard/soft/review-only class uses the exact Section-10 canonical source field, normalization, missing behavior and Decimal formula; record_version_id change alone is not semantic change; multiple resolution sources are preserved as a sorted source->rule mapping; shared-source rule hashes and source-id sets are compared separately; any comparable shared token crossing a soft threshold emits the class once with affected token ids.
items.validation_rule: Table-driven oracle covers status/condition/token/outcome/rule/source/tick/min-order/last/mid/spread/depth/question/category and >= threshold boundary.
items.safe_output: typed alphachange event or explicit gap/review-only evidence

items.required_rule: Prior/current set-difference semantics require an exact nullable comparison_prior_universe_id. With null prior id there is no newly/prior-only classification. With a supplied prior id, current-only market is NEWLY_OBSERVED_LOCALLY with no fabricated prior MaterialChangeEvent; prior-only market appears only in queue prior_only_market_ids as NO_LONGER_OBSERVED_LOCALLY, gets no current triage/reopen, and local absence is not claimed as exchange disappearance. Comparison-derived triage/queue identities bind the exact prior universe id.
items.validation_rule: Set difference alone never triggers reopen or market-closure claim; without comparison_prior_universe_id no set-difference classification exists; swapping the prior id changes comparison-bound downstream identity.

items.required_rule: Rows T1-T9 are first-match authoritative. Metadata status/conflict/staleness controls defer/ineligible; rule/book/optional metadata gaps are overlay-only; historical Alpha unavailable maps to MARKET_EVIDENCE_ONLY; current exact Alpha match/material/reopen state determines the remaining classes.
items.validation_rule: One table-driven test proves eligibility, class, reopen, readiness, reasons, requests and core/explore/audit flags for every row/overlay.

items.required_rule: Reopen is current-memory decision only. Episodes are grouped by exact (candidate_id,hypothesis_family_id) and leaves are determined within each group. WATCH_FOR_CHANGE/RESEARCH_STALE plus reopen-material same-market change may be REOPEN_ELIGIBLE only with one unambiguous governing group; multiple groups, ambiguous groups, or any matched candidate without a usable group fail closed to REOPEN_REVIEW_REQUIRED. Other listed states are review/no-auto; ALPHA-01 is never mutated.
items.validation_rule: Historical posture disables reopen and Alpha registry bytes remain unchanged; two exact-matched candidates cannot borrow one candidate's WATCH_FOR_CHANGE leaf when the other has no usable lineage.

items.required_rule: Core priority vector is exactly class rank ASC, hard change count DESC, soft change count DESC, readiness rank ASC, market_id ASC. Category/archetype undercoverage and prior research count are excluded from core ordering.
items.validation_rule: Input shuffle leaves ordering unchanged and each component obeys frozen direction.

items.required_rule: Exact typed matched Alpha episodes map lanes/producer to coverage only by the Section-14 table; SUPPORTED outranks PARTIAL; unmapped cells remain UNKNOWN; historical Alpha-unavailable posture makes all Alpha-derived cells UNKNOWN.
items.validation_rule: No prose/category/LLM inference or invented mapping for wallet/latency/behavior/data-publication cells.

items.required_rule: Allocation consumes the complete internal PreAllocationTriageBasis set, including exact nullable comparison_prior_universe_id and non-circular capture-request payloads; final immutable MarketTriageDecision records are materialized only after allocation; AlphaResearchQueueSnapshot only validates/indexes finalized decisions and never recomputes allocation.
items.validation_rule: Same semantic bases in any input order yield identical final triage ids and queue id.

items.required_rule: Core reserves exploration/audit slots first and uses exact fixed core capacity/vector/cap; exploration uses current category count ASC, supported coverage count ASC, partial count ASC, core vector, market id; audit uses exact SHA-256 seed order; unused exploration/audit reservations NEVER return to core in v1, so realized selected_count may be below queue_capacity and unused-slot counts/reasons are persisted.
items.validation_rule: Category monopoly, lane duplication, outcome-informed audit, nonreplayable selection, or optional backfill of reserved capacity fail.
items.safe_output: bounded deterministic allocation and audit design fraction

items.required_rule: Only MARKET_METADATA_REFRESH, ORDER_BOOK, RESOLUTION_RULE and SOURCE_SNAPSHOT requests are emitted by exact decision-table gaps; they are data, never network/scheduler authority. Embedded requests may bind only pre-allocation semantic inputs and MUST NOT contain final MarketTriageDecision/AlphaResearchQueueSnapshot ids, final lane or other post-allocation values. No FEE_CONFIG trigger exists in v1.
items.validation_rule: New source modules have no public-client/http/websocket/Hermes/scheduler calls/imports and capture-request serialization is one-way/non-circular.

items.required_rule: Separate s10-alpha-discovery-registry uses application_id 1464877426, user_version 1, canonical kind order POLICY->UNIVERSE->MATERIAL_CHANGE->TRIAGE_DECISION->RESEARCH_QUEUE, hash chain, explicit .sqlite3 path, no update/delete, deterministic append/idempotency and strict cross-record references.
items.validation_rule: Foreign/tampered/collision/missing-ref fails closed; one invalid batch rolls back; caller order cannot alter bytes.

items.required_rule: One shared full semantic validator covers all five persisted records and is invoked by every public builder before return, public to_mapping, public from_mapping after reconstruction, registry append serialization, and registry load/decode. Correct re-hashing never legitimizes semantically invalid content. Closed strict mappings reject floats/nonfinite/unknown fields and preserve true advisory/no-execution/no-strategy/no-qualification booleans; no qualification/expected-return/order/paper/live fields.
items.validation_rule: A correctly re-hashed MarketTriageDecision with historical_replay_valid_for_alpha_memory=true is rejected by to_mapping, from_mapping and append; valid builder-to-mapping-to-load remains symmetric. Undeclared authority-like fields reject structurally without embedding or reconstructing forbidden live-order API identifiers.
